title: THẺ BÀI TẬP 02
subject: Present Simple & Present Continuous

sections.instruction: Read the paragraph and answer the questions:
sections.contextText:
Brian is a doctor. He looks after sick people. He usually gets up at 6.00 o'clock. Today he is late, it is 6.30 and he is still in bed. He usually goes to work by train but today he is driving to work. He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning but it is 7.30 now and he is still driving.
It's 12.00 o'clock now. He always has his lunch at 12.00 but today he isn't having lunch at 12.00, he is looking after his sick patients. It is half past seven now, Brian is watching TV. He usually watches TV at half past seven because his favorite programme starts at half past seven. Brian has his dinner at 8.30 every day and he is having dinner now.
It is 24.00 now. Brian is going to bed. He always goes to bed at 24.00.

questions.prompt: What does Brian do?
acceptedAnswers: He is a doctor. He looks after sick people.
questions.explanation: What does he do? = What is his job?

questions.prompt: What time does he usually get up?
acceptedAnswers: He usually gets up at 6.00 o'clock.
He usually gets up at six o'clock.
He usually gets up at 6 o'clock.
questions.explanation: present simple for habits: he gets up

questions.prompt: How does he usually go to work?
acceptedAnswers: He usually goes to work by train.
He goes to work by train.

questions.prompt: Why is he driving to work today?
acceptedAnswers: He is driving to work because he is late.

questions.prompt: What time does he arrive at work every day?
acceptedAnswers: He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning.
He arrives at work at half past six.
questions.explanation: He arrives at work at 6.30 every morning.

questions.prompt: When does he always have his lunch?
acceptedAnswers: He always has his lunch at 12.00.
He always has his lunch at 12 o'clock.
He always has his lunch at twelve o'clock.

questions.prompt: What is he doing at 12.00 today?
acceptedAnswers: He is looking after his sick patients.
He is looking after sick patients.
He is looking after his patients.

questions.prompt: Why does he usually watch TV at 7.30?
acceptedAnswers: Because his favorite programme starts at half past seven.
Because his favorite programme starts at 7.30.
Because his favourite programme starts at half past seven.
Because his favourite programme starts at 7.30.

questions.prompt: What time does he go to bed?
acceptedAnswers: He always goes to bed at 24.00.
He goes to bed at midnight.
He always goes to bed at midnight.
questions.explanation: He always goes to bed at 24.00.

questions.prompt: What time is he going to bed now?
acceptedAnswers: He is going to bed at 24.00.
He is going to bed at midnight.
questions.explanation: It is 24.00 now and he is going to bed.

sections.contextText: Right now I am looking at a picture of Barbara. She is not at home in the picture. She is at the park. She is sitting on a bench. She is eating her lunch. She always watches squirrels when she eats her lunch in the park. Some ducks are swimming in the pond in the picture, and some birds are flying in the sky. A policeman is riding a horse. He rides a horse in the park every day. Near Barbara, a family is having a picnic. They go on a picnic every week.

sections.instruction: Read the following text and answer the questions. Questions 11–15: write True or False.
sections.contextText:
My name is Kate O'Hara. I live on a farm with my mother and father. I like it but I work very hard. Every morning I wake up at five o'clock and feed the horses. Then I can go back to the house. Mum makes breakfast at 5:30 and I'm not late for breakfast because I don't like cold eggs. After breakfast I help dad for an hour. Then I have a shower and get ready for school. The school bus leaves at 8:15. I leave home at 8:00.
After school I can watch TV for an hour. Then we have our dinner. We have chicken for dinner but I hate it. I eat it because mum gets angry. After dinner I do my homework. Then I go out and feed the horses. I go to bed early because I'm always very tired at the end of the day.

sections.instruction: Answer the questions.
sections.contextText:
JAMAICA is a large island in the Caribbean Sea. Nearly a million tourists visit the island every year to relax in the sun and swim in the clear blue sea.
For tourists, the island is a paradise, but for most Jamaican people life is hard. There are very few jobs, except in the tourist industry.
Jamaica is also famous for reggae music.

Dear Chilli,
I had a fantastic holiday in Jamaica. It was hot and the sea was blue and lovely.
I travelled by plane from London to Kingston. I really enjoyed the flight. It was eight hours long but I didn't sleep at all because I was so excited. During the flight I listened to music, watched a film and talked to the girl in the seat next to me.
I stayed with my aunt and uncle in Kingston. They invited me on a trip to Montego Bay. We stopped at an Orchid Farm. It was brilliant. On my last night there I didn't get to bed until three o'clock in the morning!
See you soon!
Love,
Della
